blurb: Luxury Jet Ski Rentals offers guests the opportunity to rent premium jet skis, Sea-Doo Switch pontoon boats, kayaks, paddle boards, and beach cruiser bikes. Their rentals are designed for easy, upscale experiences and launch directly from local marinas—no towing needed. All equipment is new or within one model year and includes safety briefings and required gear. Rentals are suitable for couples, families, small groups, and first-time riders.
extraNote: No fuel fees, security deposits, or hidden costs for jet skis · Late arrivals may reduce ride time · If weather or water conditions are unsuitable, rentals may be delayed or rescheduled for safety · No refunds for not understanding rider or group requirements · @ Coronado Island Marriott 2000 Second Street Coronado, CA 92118 OR @ Pier 32 Marina 3201 Marina Way National City, CA 91950
